0022600229.text: The Timberwolves (8-3, first in the Northwest and fourth in the West, on a four-game winning streak, 4-1 at home) host the Mavericks (7-4, third in the Southwest and 2.5 games back, eighth in the West, on a three-game winning streak) in Minnesota's 12th game of the season. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery), while Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Morez Johnson Jr. is day-to-day with a lower leg bruise and a game-time decision. The teams have not played each other yet this season, but Minnesota won all four meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently a 124-94 victory in Dallas on March 30, 2026.
